description: ANCHORAGE, AK – Alaska Teamsters Local 959 today announced its endorsement of Senator Dan Sullivan’s (R-Alaska) re-election, underscoring the union’s long-standing role in building Alaska’s economy and its confidence in Senator Sullivan’s leadership on behalf of working families statewide. In making the endorsement, Local 959 pointed to its decades-long history representing thousands of Alaskans across […]

title: Alaska Teamsters Local 959 Endorses Senator Dan Sullivan’s Re-Election - Dan Sullivan for Alaska
